decision.message: installing a package runs its maintainer scripts as root
decision.hint: approve after checking the package and its source

diffs.to:
# Mamela's APT source docker (NodeAptRepo): change the declaration, not this file.
Types: deb
URIs: https://download.docker.com/linux/ubuntu
Suites: noble
Components: stable
Signed-By: /etc/apt/keyrings/mamela-docker.asc

/etc/apt/keyrings/mamela-docker.asc (0644 root:root) if the downloaded key is ASCII-armored, as Signed-By names it above; /etc/apt/keyrings/mamela-docker.gpg if it is binary, which Signed-By then names instead; the file of the other form is removed
apt reads the package lists of every source again (apt-get update)

decision.message: adds an APT source and the key that signs it on the node as root, and runs apt-get update: apt then installs packages of this source too, a package of it with a higher version replaces the system's own (apt installs the highest version), and its maintainer scripts run as root
decision.hint: check the URIs and the key's sha256 against the vendor's instructions; a package of this source is installed only from an origin the policy allows (allowedAptOrigins) and the node's mamelet allows (allowedOrigins in /etc/mamelet/config.json)
